Package service

Class UserService

java.lang.Object
service.AbstractService<Long,User,UserRepository>
service.UserService
public class UserService extends AbstractService<Long,User,UserRepository>
Service for managing the users of the social network. Usernames and emails must be unique, and removing a user also removes all their friendships, so the users and friendships stay consistent.
